Lumbee Voices

In the Community

Out among the people

On Stage

Chicora, performed

Chicora and the Little People: The Legend of the Indian Corn was set for piano and narrator by UNCP professors Lindsey Jacob and Mark Tollefsen, and performed as a special feature of the Gather Hear Tour — a classical piano & rap concert with pianist Miki Sawada and Chris Thompson.

Two Streams Community Building, 16 Rosie’s Drive, Maxton, North Carolina · Friday, October 24, 2025 · Free admission.
